join.q: How do I join the server?
join.a: Press "Join the server" or open the CS2 console (the ~ key) and type connect {address}. If the console does not open, enable it in the game settings (Game → Enable Developer Console).

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No — all you need is Counter-Strike 2 on Steam. The de_dust2 map ships with the game and the server needs no mods on your side.

mode.a: Free-for-all Deathmatch on de_dust2 only: you respawn instantly, with no teams and no rounds. The weapon modes rotate from time to time — the current one is shown in the status above.

xp.q: How do I earn XP and levels?
xp.a: By getting kills: 10 XP each plus bonuses for headshots, knife kills, noscopes, wallbangs, kills through smoke, revenge and claimed bounties. Level n needs 100 · n · (n − 1) / 2 XP in total.

bots.a: No — a kill involving a bot gives no XP and is not recorded, so nobody can farm an empty server.

vip.q: Does VIP give an in-game advantage?
vip.a: No — VIP is cosmetic only: a tag, a name colour and a reserved slot. Nothing that affects the game itself.

stats.q: Where can I see my stats?
stats.a: On the leaderboard — find your name and open your profile. It shows K/D, accuracy, weapon mastery and a map of your kills for the last 30 days.

skins.q: Are there skins, knives or ranks?
skins.a: No — the server follows Valve's community server guidelines, which forbid plugins for skins, knives, gloves, agents and fake ranks.

banned.q: I was banned unfairly — what can I do?
banned.a: Write to us through the contact page with your SteamID64 and the date of the ban. Appeals with Steam sign-in are coming soon.

ammo.d: The reserve refills on every reload. Shoot without counting.

protect.d: After every respawn you are protected for five seconds — nobody can kill you while you get your bearings.

awp.d: The sniper is in, capped at 3 at the same time on the server — the other weapons still get their share.

how.title: How XP and levels work
how.lead: Every kill earns XP and the bonuses add up. Kills involving a bot do not count.
how.level: Your level comes from your total XP: level n needs 100 · n · (n − 1) / 2 XP — 100 for level 2, 300 for level 3, 4500 for level 10.
how.bounty: A streak of {min} kills without dying puts a bounty on your head: 25 XP for every kill after the fourth, up to {cap} XP. Whoever takes you down claims it.
how.revenge: If someone has killed you at least 3 times in a row and you take them down, that is revenge — +5 XP.

vip.lead: VIP is cosmetic only — it gives no in-game advantage at all. You support the server and get a sign that you are part of it.

perks.title: What you get
items: A VIP tag before your name in chat and on the scoreboard.
A name colour in chat.
A reserved slot: you are not kicked to free up space when the server is full.

fair.title: No in-game advantage
fair.text: VIP has no extra health, no faster respawn, no better weapons and no lighter restrictions — the rules are the same as for everyone. Nobody gets skins, knives or ranks: Valve's community server guidelines forbid them.

tiers.title: Prices
tiers.name: Tier
tiers.caption: VIP tiers and prices including VAT
tiers.empty: No VIP tiers have been announced yet. The prices will appear here once they are set.

pay.title: Payment
items: Payment is manual — by bank transfer, against an invoice.
No automatic renewal: VIP ends at the end of the period, and a new period only starts on your request.
Requests through the website are coming soon. Until then, write to us through the contact page.

rules.lead: The server is about fair play and a good mood. The rules apply to everyone — VIPs and admins included.

cheats.title: No cheats
cheats.text: Programs and scripts that give an advantage are forbidden: aimbots, wallhacks, triggerbots, macros and the like. The penalty is a permanent ban.

toxicity.title: No insults
toxicity.text: No insults, threats, racism or harassment — in chat, in voice or in your name.

ads.title: No advertising
ads.text: No advertising of other servers, websites, services or sales — in chat, in voice or in your name.

exploits.title: No bug abuse
exploits.text: If you find a bug on the map or in the game that gives an advantage (for example a spot where you cannot be hit), tell us and do not use it.

impersonation.title: No impersonation
impersonation.text: Do not pretend to be an admin, another player or the server team.

spam.title: No spam
spam.text: No flooding of chat or voice and no abuse of commands.

penalties.title: Penalties
penalties.lead: The penalty depends on the violation and on whether it is repeated:
items: A warning.
Muting voice (mute), chat (gag) or both.
A kick from the server.
A temporary ban — moderators can ban for up to 7 days, administrators for longer.
A permanent ban — for cheating and for serious or repeated violations.
penalties.public: Active bans are visible on the ban list: only the name, SteamID64, category, date and expiry. The reason is not public.

appeal.title: Appeals
items: Appeals will work with Steam sign-in on this website.
Until then, write to us through the contact page with your SteamID64, the date and why you think the penalty is a mistake.
Every appeal is reviewed by a person on the team and you get a reasoned answer.

privacy.lead: How the CarbonStealth.eu | Dust2 DM server and this website process personal data — briefly and without small print.

controller.title: Who is responsible for the data
body: The controller of personal data is {company} — the publisher of the server and of the website. The company details are in the imprint; for any question about your data, write to us through the contact page.

game.title: What we record when you play
items: SteamID64 — your Steam account number; stats and penalties are kept against it.
Your in-game name (Steam nickname) at the time you play.
Your IP address when you join the server — to protect against abuse and to enforce bans; we keep it for {sessionsDays} days.
Stats: kills, deaths, assists, shots fired and hits, streaks, XP, time played and kills per weapon.
Every kill with the weapon, the time and the map coordinates — for the kill maps; we keep them for {killsDays} days.
Penalties: type, category, expiry and an internal reason that only admins can see.
Roughly the last 2000 server events (joins, kills, chat) are held briefly in working memory for moderation and are overwritten continuously; chat is not stored in the database.

website.title: What we record when you browse the website
items: The website uses no cookies, analytics, ads or trackers — which is why there is no consent banner either.
Your IP address is only used to limit the number of requests (overload protection); it is held in memory for up to 1 minute and is not written to any log.
If a player has signed in to the website with Steam, their avatar is loaded from Steam's servers (Valve) — your browser then connects to them.

purposes.title: Why, and on what legal basis
items: Running the game, stats and the public leaderboard — legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): players want to see their results. You can object — we then hide you from the leaderboards and your profile.
Security, protection against cheaters and enforcing bans (including the IP address) — legitimate interest.
A public ban list with minimal data (name, SteamID64, category, date and expiry) — legitimate interest: transparency and protecting the community. The reason is not public.
VIP — performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) and the legal obligation to keep accounting records (Art. 6(1)(c)).
Appeals and notices — legitimate interest: a decision on every case.

retention.title: How long we keep the data
items: IP addresses when joining (sessions) — {sessionsDays} days, then they are deleted automatically.
Kills with coordinates — {killsDays} days, then they are deleted automatically.
Appeals and notices — 1 year after the decision, then they are deleted automatically.
Stats — for as long as the server runs or until you ask for them to be deleted.
Penalties — for as long as they are needed for the security of the server.
Invoice details for VIP — as long as the Bulgarian Accountancy Act requires.

recipients.title: Who else sees the data
items: Every visitor sees the leaderboard, player profiles (except hidden ones) and the ban list — with the data described above.
The provider of the server that runs the game and the database processes the data on our behalf. The server is located in the EU.
Valve (Steam) processes your account data under its own policy — we do not pass anything to them.
We do not sell data, do not use it for advertising and do not transfer it outside the EU.

steam.title: Data from Steam
items: Right now the website reads nothing from the Steam Web API — it only uses the SteamID64 and nickname the game server sees when you join.
When we introduce Steam sign-in (for appeals and VIP), we will read only your public name and avatar from the Steam Web API — and only after you sign in yourself.
This data is stored on our server in the EU, is not passed to third parties and is used under the Steam Web API Terms of Use.

rights.title: Your rights
items: Access — to find out what data we hold about you and to get a copy.
Rectification and erasure, when the data is inaccurate or no longer needed.
Restriction of processing.
Portability — your stats in a machine-readable format.
Objection — including being hidden from the leaderboards and your profile.
A complaint to the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (www.cpdp.bg) or to the supervisory authority of the country where you live.
body: For any request, write to us through the contact page with your SteamID64. We may ask you to confirm that the account is yours. We reply within one month.

changes.title: Changes
body: If we change this text, the date at the top changes, and we will announce significant changes on the website.

vipTerms.lead: Short and clear: what you buy, how you pay and how you can withdraw.

provider.title: Provider
body: The VIP service is provided by {company}. The company details are in the imprint; to reach us, use the contact page.

subject.title: What you buy
body: VIP is a digital service: cosmetic features on the CarbonStealth.eu | Dust2 DM server for a set period, tied to your SteamID64. VIP gives no in-game advantage and cannot be transferred or sold.

prices.title: Prices
body: Prices are in euro including VAT and are those published on the VIP page at the time of the request. There are no hidden fees.

order.title: Request, payment and start
items: Requests will be made through the website (coming soon) with your SteamID64, invoice details and email.
You receive a confirmation and the details for a bank transfer. The invoice is issued by {company}.
VIP is activated by hand once the payment arrives. If you expressly ask for VIP to start before the 14-day withdrawal period ends, it starts right after activation.

period.title: Term and renewal
body: VIP is valid for the period of the chosen tier from activation. There is no automatic renewal and there are no automatic payments — a new period only comes with a new request.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal (14 days)
items: As a consumer, you can withdraw from the contract within 14 days of its conclusion without giving any reason.
If you expressly asked for VIP to start before the period ends, on withdrawal you pay the part proportionate to the period used until the withdrawal, and we refund the rest.
To withdraw, send us a clear statement through the contact page with your SteamID64 and the invoice number. We refund the amount within 14 days to the account it was paid from.

rules.title: Rules and penalties
body: VIP gives no immunity: the server rules and the same penalties apply as for every player.

availability.title: Server availability
body: We aim to keep the server running continuously, but Counter-Strike 2 updates from Valve and maintenance can stop it temporarily.

complaints.title: Questions and disputes
items: For questions and complaints, write to us through the contact page.
If we cannot agree, you can turn to the Bulgarian Commission for Consumer Protection (www.kzp.bg) and its conciliation committees for out-of-court dispute resolution.
Bulgarian law applies, without depriving you of the protection given to you by the law of the country where you live.

notice.title: Notice of illegal content
notice.lead: If a nickname, a message or other content on the server or the website is illegal, send a notice with:
items: Why you consider the content illegal.
Where it is — the SteamID64 or the page address, the date and the time.
Your name and email (they may be omitted only for notices about child sexual abuse).
A statement that the notice is made in good faith and is accurate to the best of your knowledge.
notice.after: We confirm receipt, decide without undue delay and tell you the decision and how you can challenge it.
